title: Daily spec
description: Ideate output. The harness renders it to journal/runs/<date>/spec.md, then locks and hashes it.

backlogId.description: Tonight's backlog ID (e.g. B03) on backlog nights; null on maintenance and invention nights.

summary.description: What gets built, in two to four sentences.

acceptanceCriteria.description: AC1..ACn in order. Each is one testable behaviour that is new tonight; never restate existing behaviour. Empty only on maintenance nights.

closestExisting.description: Invention nights (phase 2) only: the 3 closest existing items and one line on why tonight's idea differs. Empty otherwise.

expectedFiles.description: Repo paths the build is expected to add or change (src/**, new tests/**). The harness intersects them with every open PR's files for the plan audit.

supersedes.description: Modules (src/ paths) this feature replaces and deletes, so nothing is left as dead code. Empty when nothing is retired.

playtest.description: For the owner's phone test of the PR preview, in plain words with no code names. null only on maintenance nights.

whatYoullSee.description: What visibly changes in the game, one to three sentences.

howToTest.description: Steps to follow on the preview, ending in what to check.
